html: I joined the Working Group Weather Commons: On the Practice and Politics of Atmospheric Modification, organized by TBA21–Academy UNI.
Registration opened for Indigenous Cartography and GIS, a course I am co-teaching at the School for Poetic Computation this winter.
I joined the PhD/Research Workshop on Interstices: Research (in) the gaps, hosted by the Digital Aesthetics Research Center at Aarhus University.
I gave a presentation titled Operational Aesthetics of High-Dimensional Planetary Space at the annual Society for Social Studies of Science (4S) conference in Toronto.
I joined the Buell Center at Columbia University as an Adjunct Research Scholar, contributing to an ongoing project on green counting in architectural pedagogy and praxis.
I presented on Sonifying Pinna nobilis: Transcoding Tidalectic Measurement and Myth at the symposium Sensing Matters: Bodies, Experiences, and Objects at Bard Graduate College.
My graduate thesis, Embedding Earth: A Critical Atlas of Planetary Computation, was awarded the GSAPP Writing Prize.
I started working as a Research Assistant for the Impacts Group within the Center for Climate Systems Research at Columbia University.
